# Worklist and case setup {#sec-worklist}

## Start a review session

**Purpose.** Open the workstation and select the Workspace that contains the cases for the current review session.

**Procedure.**

1. Start the review workstation using the local launcher provided by the operator.
2. Open `http://127.0.0.1:8000/app/`.
3. Open **Settings** and select or create the approved Workspace.
4. Return to **Worklist** and choose **Scan input folder**.

**Expected result.** The Worklist shows admitted files with plain-language status and available actions. Original source files remain unchanged.

## Confirm Image

**Purpose.** Confirm the image context before analysis or downstream clinical review.

**Before you begin.** Open a case with **Confirm Image** available. Filename or resolver suggestions are evidence only until you confirm them.

**Procedure.**

1. Choose **Confirm Image** in the case action menu.
2. Review the displayed filename and admission status.
3. Enter or clear **Pseudonymous patient key**. Leave it empty when the case should remain unlinked.
4. Set **Eye** to **Left**, **Right**, or **Unknown**.
5. Enter **Reviewer name**, or use the workstation default when appropriate.
6. Choose **Confirm Image**.

**Expected result.** The patient and eye context, reviewer, timestamp, and image-confirmation milestone are saved. A supported fundus image can proceed to **Review**.

::: {.callout-important title="IMPORTANT - reviewer preference"}
The default reviewer is a browser-local convenience, not an authenticated identity. On a shared workstation, change or clear it when the user changes. Previously saved reviewer names are not rewritten.
:::

![Worklist overview](screenshots/01-worklist.png){#fig-worklist fig-cap="Worklist orientation: use the case row and action menu to enter Confirm Image."}

## Admission exceptions

Use the visible case status to decide the next action. A recognized MRI or other non-fundus DICOM remains **Unsupported modality**. Do not send it to RETFound or PRISM-DR.

::: {.callout-caution title="CAUTION - source files"}
Do not rename, move, overwrite, or recompress admitted source images from the review workstation. Work with the recorded source and derived display paths.
:::
